notes.title: Memories of Glass Maiden released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869837/d37bab2a1ff6b608744fef5f4f6858378273dd1b.png[/img]

Hello, GLASS fans!

Since we launched the GLASS series, we've received a lot of requests from our fans.

One request stood out to us.
They wanted us to create a separate game where they could just enjoy the story and world of GLASS.

So we did! We made it! Memories of Glass Maiden!

Released today, Memories of the Glass Maiden (MOG) contains the story of GLASS 2.
We'll continue to update it with stories from GLASS 1 and private stories as well.

Please visit MOG when you want to immerse yourself in the GLASS world!

We look forward to seeing you in the future.

Thank you.

* MOG currently contains the story of GLASS 2. If you have already played GLASS 2, you don't need to purchase it now. We will notify you in the news when the new story is updated, so be sure to set your alarm~!
